<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*The [[Governor of the Reserve Bank of India]], [[Urjit Patel]], resigns abruptly. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-cenbank-governor/indian-central-bank-head-quits-after-months-of-government-pressure-idUSKBN1O91GX (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Brexit]]
**The [[Court of Justice of the European Union]] rules that an EU member state's invocation of [[Withdrawal from the European Union|Article 50 TEU]] is unilaterally revokable. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-46481643 (BBC)]
**Prime Minister [[Theresa May]] announces the deferral of the [[meaningful vote]] on the UK's negotiated [[United Kingdom invocation of Article 50 of the Treaty on European Union|withdrawal agreement from the European Union]] that was scheduled for tomorrow. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-46509288 (BBC)]
*164 countries adopt the non-binding [[Global Compact for Migration|Global Compact for Safe, Orderly and Regular Migration]] in [[Marrakech]], [[Morocco]]. [https://www.upi.com/164-nations-not-US-sign-global-pact-to-safeguard-migrants/9131544446709/ (UPI)]

;Law and crime
*[[Death of Grace Millane]]
**[[New Zealand]] [[Prime Minister of New Zealand|Prime Minister]] [[Jacinda Ardern]] makes a public apology to the family of Grace Millane, who was murdered in [[Auckland]] on 1 or 2 December 2018, saying that "your daughter should have been safe here". [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/10/grace-millane-accused-appears-in-court-for-the-first-time (''The Guardian'')]
*Thirty-three people are hospitalized in [[Pavia]], [[Lombardy]], [[Italy]], after [[pepper spray]] was fired inside the gym of a school. This is the second pepper spray-related incident in the country in three days. On 8 December, six people died when someone fired the spray inside a nightclub, causing a [[Corinaldo stampede|stampede]]. [https://www.ilmessaggero.it/italia/spray_urticante_scuola_pavia-4163090.html (''Il Messaggero'')]
*[[Russians|Russian]] [[serial killer]] and former policeman [[Mikhail Popkov]] is convicted of an additional 56 murders between 1992 and 2007. All of his victims were women. [https://news.sky.com/story/werewolf-killer-mikhail-popkov-convicted-of-56-more-murders-11576856 (Sky News)]
*[[Russell Bishop (sex offender)|Russell Bishop]] is convicted of [[Babes in the Wood murders (Wild Park)|the murder of Karen Hadaway and Nicola Fellows]]. He had been tried and found not guilty of the crimes in 1987, but the acquittal was quashed as new evidence in the form of DNA was now available. Bishop had been convicted in December 1990 of the abduction, indecent assault and attempted murder of a seven-year-old girl in February of that year. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/dec/10/man-found-guilty-of-1986-brighton-babes-in-the-wood-murders-karen-hadaway-nicola-fellows (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Nissan]], the company's former chairman [[Carlos Ghosn]], and an aide are indicted on charges that Ghosn underreported about ¥5 billion ($44.5 million) of his income. Ghosn's arrest warrant is renewed. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2018/12/4c3d6e7f47e5-urgent-tokyo-prosecutors-indict-ex-nissan-boss-ghosn.html (Kyodo News)]
*Former [[Guantanamo Bay detention camp|Guantanamo Bay]] detainee [[Omar Khadr]] asks for a [[Canadian passport]] to travel to [[Saudi Arabia]] and speak with his sister [[Khadr family#Zaynab Khadr|Zaynab Khadr]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton/omar-khadr-passport-travel-saudi-arabia-sister-1.4940009 (CBC CA)] [https://calgaryherald.com/news/canada/omar-khadr-to-ask-for-canadian-passport-to-travel-permission-to-speak-to-sister-2/wcm/f457d73a-f215-4743-b2f0-56028eef513f (''Calgary Herald'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Yellow vests movement]]
**[[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] addresses the country following the yellow vests protests. While refusing to reinstate a [[wealth tax]] or back down on the current reform agenda, he promises an increase to the [[minimum wage]] and to remove some taxes on low income earners. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-protests-economy-lemaire/to-quell-unrest-frances-macron-speeds-up-tax-cuts-but-vows-no-u-turn-idUSKBN1O90LP (Reuters)]
*[[2018 Armenian parliamentary election]]
**Acting [[Prime Minister of Armenia|Prime Minister]] [[Nikol Pashinyan]]'s [[My Step Alliance]] bloc wins 70.4% of the vote. [https://armenpress.am/eng/news/957618/ (Armenpress)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-armenia-election/acting-armenian-pms-bloc-wins-parliamentary-vote-commission-idUSKBN1O80TK (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*[[NASA]] announces that ''[[Voyager 2]]'' entered into the [[interstellar medium]] after exiting the [[heliosphere]] on November 5. [https://www.nasa.gov/press-release/nasa-s-voyager-2-probe-enters-interstellar-space (NASA)]
